title.en: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Robotics for physical-world control
title.zhHans: Google DeepMind 发布面向物理世界控制的 Gemini Robotics

summary.en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics and Gemini Robotics-ER, extending Gemini 2.0 with vision-language-action control and embodied spatial reasoning for robots.
summary.zhHans: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini Robotics 与 Gemini Robotics-ER，把 Gemini 2.0 扩展到机器人的视觉—语言—动作控制与具身空间推理。

narrative.en: Gemini Robotics connected a frontier multimodal model family to direct robot control. The launch was an important research-platform milestone, but the evidence at release consisted mainly of model reports and demonstrations rather than sustained customer deployment.
narrative.zhHans: Gemini Robotics 把前沿多模态模型家族连接到了机器人直接控制。它是重要的研究平台节点，但发布时的证据主要仍是模型报告和演示，而不是持续的客户部署。

description.en: The model family added physical actions and embodied spatial reasoning to a general-purpose multimodal foundation, demonstrating broader task and environment generalization in controlled evaluations.
description.zhHans: 该模型家族把物理动作与具身空间推理加入通用多模态基础模型，并在受控评测中展示了更广的任务与环境泛化能力。

description.en: The release made robotics a first-class extension of a frontier multimodal model family rather than a separate specialist stack.
description.zhHans: 这次发布让机器人能力成为前沿多模态模型家族的一等扩展，而不再只是独立的专用技术栈。

text.en: Google DeepMind launched Gemini Robotics and Gemini Robotics-ER on March 12, 2025.
text.zhHans: Google DeepMind 于 2025 年 3 月 12 日发布 Gemini Robotics 与 Gemini Robotics-ER。
